name: Global Splat Merge and Rendering
definition: A technique to merge multiple independent Gsplat renderers into a single global draw call by packing their splat data, SH coefficients, and depth/order information into shared global buffers, then performing a cascaded merge of depth-sorted orders.
summary: Global Splat Merge and Rendering consolidates multiple Gaussian splat renderers into a single globally depth-sorted draw call to reduce overdraw and improve sorting accuracy.
